Overview

Ilorin is a city in Kwara with a population of 1,050,000. The capital of Kwara State, known as a major agricultural center and gateway between northern and southern Nigeria. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
